summary.title: Case Summary
summary.summary: 1,143 transactions worth ₹17,447,360 across 5 employees. Biggest spender: E1 with ₹8,398,115.
summary.code:
def analyze(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Analysis:
    # describe() gives count, mean, std, min, quartiles and max for every employee
    by_employee = df.groupby("employee_id")["amount"]
    table = by_employee.describe()[["count", "mean", "std", "min", "50%", "max"]]
    table["total"] = by_employee.sum()
    table = table.rename(columns={"50%": "median"}).round(2).reset_index()

    top = table.loc[table["total"].idxmax()]
    return Analysis(
        title="Case Summary",
        summary=(
            f"{len(df):,} transactions worth ₹{df['amount'].sum():,.0f} across "
            f"{df['employee_id'].nunique()} employees. Biggest spender: "
            f"{top['employee_id']} with ₹{top['total']:,.0f}."
        ),
        stats={"n_rows": len(df), "total_spend": round(float(df["amount"].sum()), 2)},
        implicates=[],  # a summary describes — it never accuses
        table=table,
        plot_data={"employees": table["employee_id"].tolist(), "totals": table["total"].tolist(),
                   "counts": table["count"].tolist(), "medians": table["median"].tolist()},
    )

zscore.title: Z-Score Scan · per employee
zscore.summary: 2 claim(s) more than 3 standard deviations from that person’s own normal. Flagged: E4.

title.text: How unusual is every claim? (per employee)

zscore.code:
def analyze(df: pd.DataFrame, scope: str = "per_employee", threshold: float = 3.0) -> Analysis:
    if scope == "global":
        # Naive: compare every claim with the whole company's claims, in raw rupees
        values = df["amount"]
        z = (values - values.mean()) / values.std()
    else:
        # Fair: compare each claim with the same person's claims in the same category.
        # Money is log-normal, so we measure distance in log10(amount).
        values = np.log10(df["amount"])
        group = values.groupby([df["employee_id"], df["category"]])
        z = (values - group.transform("mean")) / group.transform("std")

    flagged = df.loc[z.abs() > threshold].assign(z=z.round(2))
    counts = flagged["employee_id"].value_counts()
    implicates = sorted(counts.index)
    return Analysis(
        title=f"Z-Score Scan · {scope.replace('_', ' ')}",
        summary=(
            f"{len(flagged)} claim(s) more than {threshold:g} standard deviations from "
            f"{'the company average' if scope == 'global' else 'that person’s own normal'}. "
            f"Flagged: {', '.join(implicates) or 'nobody'}."
        ),
        stats={"scope": scope, "threshold": threshold, "flagged_rows": len(flagged),
               **{f"flagged_{e}": int(n) for e, n in counts.items()}},
        implicates=implicates,
        table=flagged[["txn_id", "employee_id", "category", "vendor", "amount", "z"]],
        plot_data={"employee": df["employee_id"].tolist(), "z": z.fillna(0).round(3).tolist(),
                   "amount": df["amount"].tolist(), "txn": df["txn_id"].tolist(),
                   "threshold": threshold, "scope": scope},
    )

groupby.title: Pattern Matrix · by weekday
groupby.summary: Stands out: nobody — a weekday pattern unlike everyone else's (chi-square p < 0.001).
groupby.code:
def analyze(df: pd.DataFrame, by: str = "weekday") -> Analysis:
    data = df.assign(
        weekday=pd.Categorical(pd.to_datetime(df["date"]).dt.day_name().str[:3], WEEKDAYS),
        hour_bucket=pd.cut(df["hour"], bins=[-1, 5, 11, 16, 23],
                           labels=["night (0-5)", "morning", "afternoon", "evening"]),
    )
    # rows = employees, columns = the pattern we group by, cells = number of claims
    matrix = pd.crosstab(data["employee_id"], data[by])

    if by == "vendor":
        # Habits differ, so compare exclusivity: vendors that only ONE employee ever pays
        users_per_vendor = (matrix > 0).sum()
        exclusive = matrix.loc[:, users_per_vendor == 1].sum(axis=1)
        implicates = sorted(exclusive[exclusive >= 5].index)
        stats = {f"exclusive_{e}": int(n) for e, n in exclusive.items()}
        verdict = "claims at vendors nobody else uses"
    else:
        # Chi-square: is this employee's pattern different from everyone else's?
        stats = {}
        for employee in matrix.index:
            table = np.vstack([matrix.loc[employee], matrix.drop(employee).sum()])
            table = table[:, table.sum(axis=0) > 0]
            stats[f"p_{employee}"] = float(chi2_contingency(table).pvalue)
        implicates = sorted(e for e in matrix.index if stats[f"p_{e}"] < 0.001)
        verdict = f"a {by} pattern unlike everyone else's (chi-square p < 0.001)"

    who = ", ".join(implicates) if implicates else "nobody"
    return Analysis(
        title=f"Pattern Matrix · by {by}",
        summary=f"Stands out: {who} — {verdict}.",
        stats=stats,
        implicates=implicates,
        table=matrix.reset_index().rename(columns=str),
        plot_data={"employees": matrix.index.tolist(), "columns": [str(c) for c in matrix.columns],
                   "counts": matrix.to_numpy().tolist(), "by": by, "implicates": implicates},
    )

iqr_box.title: Box & Whisker
iqr_box.summary: 2 claim(s) beyond the far-out fence (Q3 + 3·IQR) of the person's own category. Flagged: E4.

title.text: Claims vs each person's usual (same category)

iqr_box.code:
def analyze(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Analysis:
    # How many times bigger is each claim than that person's usual claim in the category?
    log_amount = np.log10(df["amount"])
    group = log_amount.groupby([df["employee_id"], df["category"]])
    q1, q3 = group.transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.25)), group.transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.75))
    iqr = q3 - q1
    size = group.transform("size")

    # Tukey's far-out fence: beyond Q3 + 3 x IQR (only for groups with enough claims)
    outside = (log_amount > q3 + 3 * iqr) & (size >= 4)
    ratio = 10 ** (log_amount - group.transform("median"))
    flagged = df.loc[outside].assign(times_usual=ratio[outside].round(1))
    implicates = sorted(flagged["employee_id"].unique())
    return Analysis(
        title="Box & Whisker",
        summary=(
            f"{len(flagged)} claim(s) beyond the far-out fence (Q3 + 3·IQR) of the person's own "
            f"category. Flagged: {', '.join(implicates) or 'nobody'}."
        ),
        stats={"flagged_rows": len(flagged),
               **{f"max_times_usual_{e}": float(ratio[df["employee_id"] == e].max())
                  for e in sorted(df["employee_id"].unique())}},
        implicates=implicates,
        table=flagged[["txn_id", "employee_id", "category", "vendor", "amount", "times_usual"]],
        plot_data={"employee": df["employee_id"].tolist(), "ratio": ratio.round(3).tolist(),
                   "outside": outside.tolist(), "txn": df["txn_id"].tolist()},
    )
